name: machinestream-mcp
description: Run builds, tests, lints and type checks remotely, on the exact state of your checkout.
long_description: MachineStream runs an AI coding agent's tests, type checks, linters and builds remotely, on the exact state of your checkout (committed, uncommitted and untracked files), and returns the same exit code and output a local run gives. This extension adds five tools: `check` runs one command, `check_parallel` runs several against one snapshot, `status` says whether checks are ready and what they cost, `setup` signs you in and turns checks on when you agree, and `run_output` reads a saved run. When the service cannot run a command it says so, and the command runs on your machine as before. Checks are billed in Context Credits by run time; see https://machinestream.io/pricing.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Run one build, test, lint or type-check command remotely on this checkout.

tools.name: check_parallel
tools.description: Run 2 to 8 commands at once against one snapshot of the checkout.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Say whether remote checks are ready here and what they cost.

tools.name: setup
tools.description: Sign in, and turn remote checks on when the user agrees.

tools.name: run_output
tools.description: Read the saved output of an earlier check without running it again.

project_directory.title: Project folder
project_directory.description: The git checkout your checks are about.

api_key.title: API key (optional)
api_key.description: API key of your MachineStream (ContextStream) account. Leave empty to sign in through the browser with the setup tool.
